source_review_note: Retained the published KDOR OVERLAND PARK monthly amounts and separately labelled distribution controls. Retained the VisitOP ACTUAL 2024, BUDGET 2025, ESTIMATED 2025 and PROPOSED 2026 columns exactly, with original URLs and page references.

fund.label: Overland Park — published-budget planning fund
fund.opening_basis: Planning opening cash is the published 2026 PROPOSED VisitOP Cash Balance 1/1 of USD 808,780 plus its separately shown Operating Reserve of USD 293,000. The resulting reserve-inclusive opening is USD 1,101,780. Use a reviewed opening ledger balance when operating an actual cash fund.
fund.allocation_basis: The City tourism-services RFP describes historical funding at two ninths of the city transient guest tax. This fraction is a planning parameter; actual funding depends on collections and City appropriation. Original RFP: https://www.opkansas.gov/asset/caaf3671-312f-4d9b-a4bd-34e6e6045640
fund.annual_plan:
Monthly close: import the next published KDOR month, record its publication URL and page, review the source, and prepare the next forecast using exact accepted editions. Keep published distributions as independent controls. City or operator cash is entered from its original ledger with entry IDs, fund, program and original-entry links for returns.

Demand and lodging: import licensed STR, AirDNA or equivalent original exports with their period and market definitions. Add a forecast adjustment only with a stated amount, month and source basis. Retain the prior seasonal forecast and its historical error for comparison.

Quarterly reporting: review the three monthly observations or forecast components, explain the remaining forecast months, review published budget arithmetic and cash activity, and export the finalized workbook and source package. The partner prepares the operating narrative and annual plan; the City's reporting and approval process remains authoritative.

Annual planning: select the exact published budget status, document collection assumptions and planned allocation, reconcile the reserve-inclusive opening to the actual opening ledger before cash reporting, and retain each reviewed report edition. Present the annual plan and budget through the City's FAED process with the original supporting schedules.

plan.label: Overland Park 2026 — collections through August
plan.assumptions: The base projection scales each remaining prior-year calendar month by the ratio of the latest six known months to their exact prior-year counterparts. Collection amounts use the KDOR 98% net basis, with no additional administration deduction. Downside and upside vary this growth factor by five percentage points. The rolling historical check uses earlier calendar-month rows from the retained source editions; its results describe historical forecasting error on those editions. No event adjustment is entered. The source packet contains no operator cash, lodging or event-demand rows.
